notes.title: Patch v 1.05: Resolution selection. Plus SpeedRunning event
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/G9VCkDb.png[/img]

Hi all

We just pushed out an update for Windows that adds resolution selection. You can hold SHIFT before launching the game to get a prompt up. Working on properly integrating it into the game options. 

[h1]Full update log since launch:[/h1]

v 1.05

- Added resolution selection based on popular demand (for Windows)
hold shift before launching the game to get resolution selection prompt
- Fixed a bug in the flying level

v 1.04

Popped a bottle of champagne
- Fixed the cake universe bug when you sometimes can't break blocks

v 1.03

- Actually fixed a bug where the mouse cursor would go out of the screen infinitely
- Fixed a bug where sometimes during space ship boss you'd get stuck on the spheres

v 1.02

Realized the Mac and Linux depots were not included. Ran around the office and panicked. Took some (legal in NL) substances to calm down. Figured out that I forgot to tick the boxes that include those in the packages. Now Mac and Linux are live. 

v 1.01

Drank too much extra dry martini. Got dry eyes in the morning, pushed the game live to realize that I forgot to tick the proper box to grant all owners of the original the free Remastered build. Crap. 

v 1.00

Released the game on Steam, Mac and Linux

[h1]SpeedRunning event on Monday, July 20[/h1]

Tonight there's a SpeedRunning event for No Time To Explain happening at 7pm PST. It will be featured on the frontpage of http://twitch.tv -- tune it to see people break the game :)

notes.title: No Time To Explain is live! Hotfixes and Launch Trailer
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/mpfftfa.png[/img]

No Time To Explain Remastered is now out on Steam, and available for free to everyone who owns the original! Enjoy. 

We made a few hotfixes today, including

[list][*]Fixed the cake levels being unbeatable under certain conditions with blocks
[*]Fixed the cursor being able to get out of the screen... like really far away
[*]Fixed a rare glitch in the inside-space-ship-boss where you could get stuck
[/list]

Enjoy!

Let's celebrate with a LAUNCH TRAILER! 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=W6EBjsIx6N8
